!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = cell type: endometrial stromal cells
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = treatment: glucocorticoid receptor siRNA
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Primary human endometrial stromal cells were transfected using the ProFection mammalian transfection kit (Promega, Madison, WI), with 100 nM per well of the following siRNA reagents (Dharmacon, Lafayette, CO): siCONTROL non-targeting (NT) siRNA pool (Group A), GR siGENOME SMARTpool siRNA (Group B), or MR siGENOME SMARTpool siRNA (Group C). In decidualization experiments, confluent monolayers were maintained in DMEM/F12 now containing 2% DCC-FBS and treated with 0.5mM 8-bromoadenosine cAMP (8-bromo-cAMP; Sigma, St Louis, MO), 1μM progesterone (P4; Sigma), and 0.1μM cortisone (E; Sigma) for four days.
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Endometrial samples were obtained from premenopausal women without uterine pathology and human endometrial stromal cells were isolated, cultured and maintained. The tissues were washed twice in a 1:1 mixture of DMEM and Ham's F12 (DMEM/F12) (Sigma, Poole, UK), finely minced, and enzymatically digested with collagenase (134 U/ml) and deoxyribonuclease type I (156 U/ml) (Sigma, Poole, UK) for 1 h at 37°C. After centrifugation at 400 xg for 4 min the pellet was resuspended in maintenance medium of DMEM/F12 containing 10% dextran coated charcoal treated fetal bovine serum (DCC-FBS), 1% L-glutamine and 1% antibiotic-antimycotic solution. Proliferating endometrial stromal cells were cultured in maintenance medium until confluence.
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was extracted using STAT-60 reagent (AMS Biotechnology, Abingdon, UK). RNA quality was analyzed on an Agilent 2100 bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies, Waldbronn, Germany).  All samples had RIN >9.6.
!Sample_label_ch1 = biotin
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = NuGen Encore Biotin Module as per manufacturer's protocol on cDNA prepared using Ovation Pico SL Kit according to manufacturer's protocol.

!Sample_scan_protocol = Affymetrix GeneChip 7G Scanner according to standard protocol.
